_help: The home page. banners = the large slides at the top (after featured events and the next holiday). tiles = the smaller banners. highlights = what Chabad of Lamorinda has built. stats = big numbers, e.g. {"id": "families", "number": "300+", "label": "families"} (only real numbers from the Rabbi). A banner or tile can point at a program ("program": "hebrew-school") to use its name and summary, or have its own title and text. art = a picture name from site/assets/art; theme = navy, blue, green, gold or burgundy; image = /media/... photo (free photos in site/media/photos, see CREDITS.md; real community photos are best). story = the "Our story" section.

banners.title: Shabbat at Chabad of Lamorinda
banners.text: Kabbalat Shabbat on Friday at {kabbalat-shabbat}, and Shabbat services on Saturday at 10 AM with a hot Kiddush lunch. Everyone is welcome, no membership needed.

tiles.title: Sponsor a Kiddush
tiles.text: Mark a birthday, anniversary or yahrzeit with the whole community at the Shabbat Kiddush.

highlights.title: Lamorinda Jewish Preschool
highlights.text: A warm Jewish start for the youngest children, directed by Rebbetzin Tzipora Labkowski.

highlights.title: Lamorinda Hebrew School
highlights.text: Hebrew reading, the holidays and Bar and Bat Mitzvah preparation for ages 3 to 13, every Sunday.

highlights.title: Shabbat every week
highlights.text: Services, a hot Kiddush lunch and Shabbat dinners with the Rabbi's family, for anyone who wants to come.

highlights.title: Bay Kosher
highlights.text: Kosher meat, groceries and Judaica delivered across the area, a project of Chabad of Lamorinda.

highlights.title: There in every moment
highlights.text: Hospital visits, weddings, funerals, shiva and private help for families, from beginning to end.

highlights.title: No membership, no dues
highlights.text: Every Jew belongs. The community is carried by partners who give monthly in the Chai Club.

story.title: Our story
story.text: In 2015, Rabbi Yisroel and Tzipora Labkowski moved from Brooklyn to Lafayette with one hope: that every Jew in Lafayette, Moraga and Orinda would have a warm Jewish home to walk into. There is no membership and no dues. Whoever you are and whatever you know, you belong here.

timeline.text: The Labkowskis arrive from Brooklyn. The first High Holiday services are held at the Lafayette Library.
The Chabad center opens its doors in Lafayette.
Kosher meat comes to Contra Costa County, sold right at the center.
A preschool, a Hebrew School, Shabbat every week, classes, holidays and a helping hand for every family.
